data.body: Root verification confirmed representative client-audience mixing. README.md places Git version test enforcement, source asset paths, and the developer E2E tier beside installation and usage guidance. docs/jira-sync-setup.md exposes internal mapper symbols, ticket references, rollout details, and repository workflow assumptions in operator setup. docs/user-guide.md explains the internal blame selection algorithm in the client workflow. CHANGELOG.md and docs/release-notes.md both contain implementation measurements or execution chronology beyond their stated user and contract-change roles. These are placement candidates, not claims that all referenced detail should be deleted.
